name: amigit
readme:
Short:        Local-only git client for AmigaOS 3.x
Type:         dev/misc
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0
Uploader:     duncan@bowring.us
Author:       Duncan Bowring (amiport, built on libgit2)
Version:      0.1
URL:          https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport

amigit -- Local-only git client for AmigaOS 3.x

An amiport-native git CLI built on libgit2 1.8.5. Local repositories
only; no network commands (no clone/fetch/push/pull/remote). Covers
the v1 ten-command core: version, init, status, log, show, diff,
add, commit, checkout, branch, tag. Upstream git is infeasible on
AmigaOS because its command dispatch is built on fork()/execvp(),
which AmigaOS does not provide; libgit2 is embedded directly into
the binary instead.

Project: https://github.com/bdgscotland/amiport
Built on: libgit2 1.8.5, zlib 1.3.1, amiport posix-shim

Cross-compiled with m68k-amigaos-gcc 6.5.0b for AmigaOS 3.x (68020+).
Tested in FS-UAE (Amiga 1200) with 81/81 functional tests passing.

Usage:
  amigit version                      Print version info
  amigit init [--bare] [path]         Create an empty repository
  amigit status [-s]                  Show worktree and index state
  amigit log [-n N]                   Walk HEAD's commit history
  amigit show <ref>                   Show a commit with its diff
  amigit diff [--cached]              Unified diff (worktree or staged)
  amigit add <path>...                Stage files into the index
  amigit commit -m <msg>               Record a commit (single-word msg)
  amigit checkout <ref>               Switch HEAD to a branch or tag
  amigit branch [-l] [-d] [name]      List/create/delete branches
  amigit tag [-l] [name]              List or create lightweight tags

Exit codes (Amiga-native):
  0  = success (RETURN_OK)
  10 = any error (RETURN_ERROR)
  20 = fatal (RETURN_FAIL)

AmigaDOS path support: paths may use POSIX or AmigaDOS syntax.
Volume-rooted paths (T:repo, WORK:project) are rewritten internally
to the libgit2-friendly form (T:/repo, WORK:/project) before being
handed to libgit2. Test harness wrappers apply the same rewrite so
shell CD and amigit see the same directories.

Environment variables (for commit author/committer identity):
  GIT_AUTHOR_NAME         (default: amigit user)
  GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL        (default: amigit@localhost)
  GIT_COMMITTER_NAME      (default: amigit user)
  GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL     (default: amigit@localhost)

Known limitations:
  - No network commands. clone/fetch/push/pull/remote/submodule
    require bsdsocket + libssh2/http-shim -- a future Phase 4.
  - No merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or stash. Use a modern
    git to produce the commit graph and copy the .git directory.
  - No interactive flows (add -i, rebase -i, commit --amend with
    editor). AmigaOS has no portable $EDITOR integration.
  - Commit messages via -m must be a single shell token. AmigaDOS
    splits command-line arguments on whitespace without preserving
    quotes through Execute scripts; multi-word messages become
    separate argv entries. Work around by using underscore or dash
    separators, or by committing from a modern git and copying the
    .git directory.
  - No color output, no pager integration. Pipe amigit log through
    AmigaDOS `More` if needed.

Binary: ~1.06 MB. Stack: 256 KB. Requires 4 MB free RAM at runtime.

This is the first working git client for AmigaOS 3.x. Built on
libgit2 1.8.5 (pruned to remove networking, submodule cloning, and
failalloc harness) for a total bundled library of ~1.3 MB.

Includes full source for amigit, PORT.md documenting every porting
decision, and the FS-UAE test suite (81 functional tests).
porting_notes: First working git client for AmigaOS 3.x. Written from scratch as an amiport-native CLI on top of the pruned lib/libgit2/libgit2.a (1.8.5) because upstream git's fork()/execvp()-based command dispatch is structurally infeasible on 68k AmigaOS. Implements the PDR-010a v1 ten-command core: version, init, status, log, show, diff, add, commit, checkout, branch, tag. Two libgit2 path-handling quirks worked around at the port level (volume-rooted X:foo -> X:/foo rewrite in amigit_resolve_repo_path, and realpath(".") fix in lib/posix-shim). One FS-UAE-specific soft-float crash in libgit2's patch_generate.c worked around via __divsf3/__floatunsisf stubs in the port's link-time stubs file (crash-pattern #2: libnix mathieeesingbas ROM library broken on FS-UAE). 81/81 FS-UAE functional tests pass.
known_limitations: No network commands (clone/fetch/push/pull/remote) -- requires bsdsocket + libssh2 or http-shim in a future Phase 4. No merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or stash. No interactive flows (rebase -i, add -i, commit --amend with editor) since AmigaOS has no portable $EDITOR. Commit messages via -m must be single shell tokens -- AmigaDOS command-line parsing splits on whitespace. No color output, no pager integration. Empty initial commits rejected (no --allow-empty). Requires 4 MB free RAM at runtime.
